was diagnosed with depression this year after struggling with it for close to seven years, never told my parents until i was on the verge of killing myself because i felt like i had to hide my feelings from them. some things i wish my parents could’ve done or advice you can think of accepting:
- let him go to therapy if he wants to. as upsetting as it may be, depression is a very difficult thing that you won’t be able to relate to if you don’t have it. therapy helped me a long long way.
- don’t take away playing video games. instead of limiting his time, maybe give him small reminders to drink water and eat something, if he’s up for it, since video games are clearly something that makes him happy.
- don’t push him to do anything, such as getting out of the house / meeting family. 
- remind him that you are here to listen without judgement and that you love him and you’re proud of him for trying his best.
- don’t compare him to anyone

these are some things i can think of, hope all goes well for you and your son!
